recentItems.title: Ameesha Patel’s Mumbai House ROBBED! Domestic Help arrested over ₹5 Lakh jewellery theft
recentItems.description:
Ameesha Patel’s family home in Mumbai’s Churchgate area was allegedly targeted in a jewellery theft. A domestic help has been arrested in connection with the case after a diamond-studded gold bangle worth around ₹5 lakh reportedly went missing from her mother Asha Patel’s residence. The accused, identified as 40-year-old Seema Ghate, was traced to Virar and has been remanded to police custody. The missing jewellery has not yet been recovered.

recentItems.title: Amaal Mallik ANGRY with Salman Khan Films over Hero anniversary post: “You guys screwed up...”
recentItems.description:

Amaal called the omission an act of “audacity” and said, “you guys screwed up.” He also urged the team not to delete his comment so Salman Khan could see it.
